etymologies.etymologyHTML: From race +‎ -ial.

definitions.definition: Of or relating to a race (or a people).

quote.citation: 1712, The Art Melodious - Observations of a Musician, page 36:
quote.text: From a musical point of view, the modern Iberian seems a fac-simile of the mediæval Frenchman. Barring out racial distinctions, they both live in an analogous environment.

quote.citation: 1854, W. Stevens, Printer (publishers), The Leisure Hour - An Illustrated Magazine for Home Reading · Volume 3, page 678:
quote.text: Such extremes have always been characteristic of the barbarous northmen, and we may not be wrong in referring to racial causes for the solution of this problem of contrarieties otherwise inexplicable.

definitions.definition: (gaming) A skill possessed by all characters of a certain race.
